ns2:course.label: Intro to Film
ns2:course.description: Thoughtful viewing of diverse films (in required weekly screenings), along with ample discussion and critical reading and writing, to gain understanding of cinematic expression and of film's capacity to entertain and to exert artistic and social influence. Same as MACS 104.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students enrolling in ENGL 104 must register for one lab and one lecture-discussion section.
